_doc: Listing sources the agent fetches each run, plus the rule for reconciling them. Each source is fetched into raw/<key>.json as a normalized list; match.py merges them by normalized (address + zip).

sources.name: Redfin
sources.notes: Best structured data; reliable sold prices + days-on-market. Primary source of truth for the watchlist tracker.

sources.name: Zillow
sources.notes: Largest inventory incl. some FSBO, but flakier to fetch and noisier prices (Zestimate vs list). Lowest trust on numeric fields.

reconcile._doc: When sources disagree on a numeric field (price, beds, sqft), take the value agreed by >=2 sources; if all 3 differ, take the highest-trust source and flag it as a discrepancy on the listing.
reconcile.consensus: 2-of-3 on raw numbers, else highest trust + discrepancy flag
reconcile.address_norm: lowercase, strip punctuation, expand common abbreviations (st->street, ave->avenue, etc.), collapse whitespace
